project_title: Enterprise AI OS - File & Media Storage Integration Blueprint

overview.objective: Add an additive, editorial-grade File & Media Storage integration to WorkStudio under route /os/work/media (or /os/work/storage). It supports private audio/music library management, transcript and label manifest pairing, batch uploading with progress/retry, speech/music/mixed rights metadata editing, authenticated downloads, explicit retention notice archiving, and Training-Lab readiness assessment selection without violating RMS tenant isolation or retraining approval gates.
overview.editorial_principle: NO token-looking UUID numbers as primary document titles (e.g. avoid '3f82a910-482c-41b9-8e2b-102931a0'). All items must be identified by editorial human titles, plain-English collection names, clear asset types (Audio Stem, Speech Take, Transcript VTT, Label Manifest), and readable metadata tags.

hierarchy.title: font-family: var(--head); font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 40px); font-weight: 300;
hierarchy.label: font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 9.5px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8b8371;
hierarchy.crumb: font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase;

filters: Search by editorial title or tag
Readiness Grade (Grade A / B / C / Blocked)

batch_upload.features: Multi-file queue with progress percentage, retry failed items, verified transfer checksum and basic file-format checks. No audio-quality or duration inference in the control plane.

fields: Editorial Asset Name (e.g., Kilifi Morning Choir - Vocal Stem 01)
Language & Dialect (e.g., Swahili / Coastal Dialect, Amharic)
Rights & License Agreement (e.g., Direct Artist Grant, Public Domain, Restricted Research)
Rights Withdrawal Status (Active Clearance vs. Rights Withdrawn)

readiness_assessment.workflow_note: Select files for metadata-only training-lab readiness assessment (NOT model training). Rights and labels are operator declarations; duration, SNR, recording quality and alignment remain unmeasured until an authorized worker evaluates them.
blocker_checks: Declared labels and missing human review

archive_and_retention.retention_notice: Archiving revokes Akki access. Stored bytes and previously downloaded copies are not erased; the provider exposes no physical-delete API. Do not claim immutable retention or an unverified compliance policy.

instructions_to_main_agent: Integrate route /os/work/media into /app/frontend/src/App.js within NAV under WorkStudio.
Use existing estate.css theme styling and variables without introducing dark-mode gradient mismatches or generic blue buttons.
Provide plain-English editorial asset titles for default items (no token/uuid strings as asset names).
Ensure responsiveness for 390px mobile viewports (stacked layout, scrollable table or cards) and desktop grid.
Include explicit retention notice near Archive: access is revoked but stored bytes and previously downloaded copies are not erased.
Include full data-testid coverage as specified in data_testid_inventory.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Always include data-testid attributes on interactive components.
Maintain high UI sharpness, editorial elegance, and consistent padding.
Never rely on pure transparent backgrounds for headers or floating menus.
Do not introduce fake backend data; display explicit unbound/pending notices where live APIs are absent.
